requirements.en: Develop protective inserts from product requirements and produce controlled drawings.
requirements.zh: 依据产品要求开发保护性插衬，并制作受控图纸。

requirements.en: Plan internal trials and interpret sample-level observations without overstating field reliability.
requirements.zh: 规划内部试验，并解释样品级观察结果，不夸大现场可靠性。

requirements.en: Coordinate suppliers and production training while observing material-specification approval boundaries.
requirements.zh: 协调供应商及生产培训，同时遵守材料规格审批权限边界。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently certify packaging for hazardous-goods transport.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立认证危险货物运输包装。
